items.title: How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
items.summary: Cisco combines network intelligence with OpenAI models to strengthen enterprise security. Learn how it is building more adaptive defenses.

items.title: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer

items.title: Evernote turns AI-driven discovery into paid subscriptions
items.summary: Evernote used ChatGPT Ads to introduce its note-taking app to people working with AI. The team tracked how often free trials led to paid subscriptions.
